title: Etale near a closed subset gives an etale principal localization
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\mathfrak b\subseteq B$ an ideal. Assume that for every prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset B$ with $\mathfrak b\subseteq\mathfrak q$ there is $h\in B\setminus\mathfrak q$ such that $\operatorname{Spec}B_h\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then there is $g\in B$ whose image in $B/\mathfrak b$ is a unit such that $\operatorname{Spec}B_g\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M0 (lemma-localize-upstairs, line 1821) and its proof (the non-etale locus is closed, V(J') with V(J') ∩ V(J) empty, Algebra Lemma 00E0 lemma-Zariski-topology, 1 = f + g with f in J, g in J')

proof.text: Use HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff to translate the hypothesis and conclusion to RingHom.Etale. Let G be the set of s in B for which A -> B_s is etale, and J = Ideal.span G. If a prime P contains both b and J, the hypothesis supplies s in G outside P, contradicting Ideal.subset_span and J <= P. Thus b and J are coprime by Ideal.coprime_of_no_prime_ge, the ideal-theoretic version of [lem-weil-pbc-spec-zero-loci-disjoint-unit-ideal].

proof.text: IsCoprime.exists gives f in b and g in J with f + g = 1. Applying the quotient map shows that g maps to 1, hence to a unit.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M0 (lemma-localize-upstairs, line 1821) and its proof (the non-etale locus is closed, V(J') with V(J') ∩ V(J) empty, Algebra Lemma 00E0 lemma-Zariski-topology, 1 = f + g with f in J, g in J')

proof.text: Set T = B_g. The image of g is a unit and belongs to Ideal.map (algebraMap B T) J. Therefore this mapped ideal is top. Ideal.map_span identifies it with the ideal spanned by the images in T of G. This is the unit-ideal condition for the principal cover in [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact]; the Lean proof uses its ring-side form directly rather than constructing a scheme cover. The argument also applies when T is the zero ring.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07M0 (lemma-localize-upstairs, line 1821) and its proof (the non-etale locus is closed, V(J') with V(J') ∩ V(J) empty, Algebra Lemma 00E0 lemma-Zariski-topology, 1 = f + g with f in J, g in J')

proof.text: For s in G, put C = T_(s/1). Give C its B_s-algebra structure using IsLocalization.Away.map. The localization map identity supplies IsScalarTower B B_s C. IsLocalization.Away.commutes then proves that C is the localization of B_s away from the image of g. Consequently A -> C is etale: principal localization is etale [lem-weil-pbc-principal-localization-open-immersion] and etale maps compose [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. Mathlib packages these two facts in RingHom.Etale.propertyIsLocal.StableUnderCompositionWithLocalizationAwayTarget. Rewrite the ring map identity to obtain the etale localization of A -> T at s/1.
